# LyricTap

LyricTap is an iPhone and iPad lyric synchronization application. It makes editable line-timed lyrics, exports LRC/SRT/TXT files, and offers lyric video creation and optional AI Auto-Sync on iOS. The free browser studio uses **manual** syncing and processes selected audio locally. The browser studio does not upload audio or render MP4 videos.

## Accuracy notes
- Browser: manual lyric timing, LRC/SRT/TXT, local audio processing, no account needed.
- iOS/iPadOS app: separate optional AI Auto-Sync and lyric video workflow.
- LyricTap is not affiliated with Suno or Udio; downloaded audio files can be imported manually.
- Format support depends on the destination player or subtitle renderer.

## Website privacy
- https://569001773-wq.github.io/lyrictap-support/website-privacy/ — browser-only editing, local storage and optional analytics status.

AI Auto-Sync uses paid credits in the iOS app. The free browser tool performs manual line timing only. No official Suno or Udio affiliation. This file is a navigation aid, not an indexing or citation guarantee.
